title: Weekly rate-library drift check
instructions: Load the `estimating-reference` skill. List the organization's labor and equipment rates with mcp__bidmanager__list_labor_rates and mcp__bidmanager__list_equipment_rates, and compare them to `rates/baseline.json`. Write `reports/rate-drift-<date>.md` listing every rate that moved more than 3%. Do not modify the baseline file or any rate.
